heading: From ticket stream to one useful alert
intro: Countertop is not another dashboard to check. It is the absence of one: silence when margins hold, a single specific alert when they don't.

items.title: Connect the POS you have
items.description: OAuth into Toast, Square, or Clover in minutes. Countertop backfills ninety days of tickets so alerts start calibrated to your restaurant, not an industry average.

items.title: Invoices read themselves
items.description: Forward vendor invoices to your Countertop address. Line items are matched to menu ingredients, so plate cost updates when your supplier reprices — not when someone retypes a spreadsheet.

items.title: Drift detection tuned to you
items.description: Thresholds calibrate to each location's own history and seasonality. A taqueria's Tuesday and a steakhouse's Saturday get different definitions of normal.

items.title: One alert, with the fix attached
items.description: "Food cost up 2.3 pts, driven by chicken thighs +18% at Sysco" — each alert names the driver and the two most common fixes, in a text message, not a login.
